accessNotes: The Playbook Graphs page (v2.0, Design tab) is server-rendered and was read in full, including all do/don't captions. Exact data-viz colour tokens come from eBay Skin's published token CSS (evo-light / evo-dark, resolved against evo-core). The separate 'Graphs: Accessibility' tab was not read.
summary: eBay's graphs are seller-dashboard product UI: a white rounded card with a bold short title, optional tabs/filters/drop-down controls, faint horizontal gridlines, and a y-axis with $-abbreviated labels on the RIGHT. Colour is deliberately monochrome blue: primary blue for single series, navy + blue + a hatched light-blue for part-to-whole stacks, with teal only when more categories are needed, avoiding green/red except for trend indicators. Bars are narrow (12-24px) with tiny 2px outer corner radii.

colors.categoricalNotes: 'Chart' (bar/area/donut part-to-whole) tokens in order: primary blue-500 #0968f6, secondary blue-700 #002a69, tertiary background indigo-200 #d3effe with stroke blue-500 #0968f6 (rendered as a hatched/striped fill), quaternary background teal-300 #8edfe5 with stroke teal-600 #006f93, quinary background teal-200 #d7f4f6 with stroke teal-600. Line-graph tokens are a separate set: #0968f6 (blue-500), #271a68 (violet-700), #006f93 (teal-600), #de458e (pink-500), #a51359 (pink-600). 'Don't use colors intended for one chart type in another, such as applying line graph colors in an area chart.' Single data sets always use primary blue. Max 3 data sets by default, max 5 if the user turns on more. Colour ordering is 'defined based on number of data sets'.
colors.notes: Light tokens: --color-data-viz-grid neutral-300 #e5e5e5; --color-data-viz-labels neutral-800 #191919; --color-data-viz-legend neutral-600 #707070; legend-inactive neutral-400 #c7c7c7; legend-hover #191919; trend-positive kiwi-600 #288034; trend-negative red-600 #d50b0b; tooltip shadows #00000026 / #0000002b. Dark mode tokens: grid neutral-400, labels neutral-500, legend neutral-300, line primary blue-400, secondary indigo-200, tertiary teal-400, pink-400, pink-300; chart primary blue-500, secondary blue-300, tertiary bg blue-600/stroke blue-400, quaternary bg teal-600/stroke teal-400, quinary bg teal-700/stroke teal-400. Part-to-whole uses 'shades of blue, and teal when needed ... avoiding the use of hues like green and red'. Page background behind cards is light grey (#f7f7f7-ish in images).

axisTitle.placement: omitted (units carried in tick labels, e.g. $60k)

typography.notes: Sentence case and no ending punctuation for title, subtitle, primary metric, controls, axis labels and tooltips. Title aims for 1-2 words; subtitle 1-2 lines and must not restate the title. Optional large 'primary metric' number above the chart when one value is the main takeaway. Axis labels never angled - show every other label or wrap to 2 lines.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only, thin solid light grey (#e5e5e5) spanning the plot; no vertical gridlines.
structure.axisLine: No y-axis line; baseline at $0 drawn as a gridline (the anatomy calls it out as 'Baseline').
structure.zeroLine: Y-axis starts at 0 ('Start the Y-axis at 0 for accurate proportions'); baseline is a labelled anatomy element.
structure.unitPlacement: Currency symbol and k abbreviation on every tick ($0, $10k ... $60k).
structure.frame: White card with large rounded corners on a light-grey page; title top-left, controls (tabs, quick filters, drop-down) below or top-right.
structure.notes: Anatomy: 1 Title, 2 Tab set, 3 Scaffolding (gridlines), 4 X-axis, 5 Key, 6 Controls, 7 Y-axis, 8 Baseline. At least 16px between axis labels; mark significant time points (quarters, days of week).

legend.title: no
legend.swatchShape: small rounded square (hatched square for the patterned series)
legend.notes: Key order is the reverse of the tooltip order: the key lists segments bottom-up as they are built; tooltip lists top segment first. Legend text #707070; inactive #c7c7c7; hover #191919.

marks.bars: Narrow vertical bars: 12-16px wide on small screens, up to 24px on large, with at least 8px padding between bars. 2px corner radius on outside corners of bar segments only; 'Don't increase corner radii'. Stacked segments separated by a thin white gap. Third stacked series drawn as a light-blue fill with diagonal blue hatching and blue outline.
marks.lines: Line graph palette separate from bars (blue, violet, teal, pink, dark pink).
marks.areas: Stacked area charts allowed for totals over time.
marks.pies: Donut chart only, for a single part-to-whole breakdown within a total; progress bar linear or circular.
marks.notes: Max 3 data sets by default (5 if user enables more).

labels.dataLabels: Not printed on bars; precise values via tooltip.
labels.numberFormat: Currency with $ and k abbreviation on axis ($300k); full currency with thousands separators in KPI cards ($2,683,141); percentages to 1 decimal with green up-triangle (▲ 69.6% vs prior period).
labels.dates: Short month (Oct, Nov) or 'Mon D' (Nov 18, Dec 3).
labels.notes: Tooltip title names the date/time of the data point.

furniture.title: Required, short (1-2 words), names the data, bold, top-left of the card; optional subtitle adds missing context; optional primary metric number.
furniture.other: Controls: tabs (underlined active tab), quick filters, or pill drop-downs (e.g. 'Last 90 days'), left- or right-aligned.

layout: Responsive density: small screens keep bars 12-16px with >=8px padding (show fewer bars rather than going denser); medium/large screens either extend the time period (more bars) or keep the period and widen bars (to 24px), spacing and inset.
interaction: Web: hover/click a time period opens a tooltip ABOVE the selected period and all other shapes fade to 30% opacity. Touch: tap shows tooltip, second tap dismisses; long-press then scrub left/right. Tooltips must sit above or below all key shapes even if overlapping title/controls - never left/right where fingers cover data. Tooltip includes value and label for every data set, ordered top segment first. Tooltip has a soft drop shadow.
accessibility: All data-viz colours vetted for accessibility; hatched pattern on the tertiary series distinguishes it beyond colour; 'don't rely on the order alone to express the meaning of values'. Separate Accessibility tab not read.

discouraged: More than 3 data sets by default (5 max)
New colour themes outside the system
chartTypes.notes: Line graphs preferred over bars for small changes and long periods.

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis labels sit on the RIGHT side of the plot with currency + k abbreviation on every tick ($0 ... $60k); no y-axis title.
distinctiveRules.quote: Observed in Anatomy image (callout 7 'Y-axis' at right) and dashboard example

distinctiveRules.rule: Single data sets are always drawn in primary blue #0968f6.
distinctiveRules.quote: We use our primary blue when visualizing a single value, such as progress bars, or a single data set

distinctiveRules.rule: Part-to-whole charts use shades of blue (then teal), never green/red: navy #002a69, blue #0968f6, hatched light blue #d3effe with #0968f6 stroke.
distinctiveRules.quote: We use shades of blue, and teal when needed, to represent part-to-whole relationships ... avoiding the use of hues like green and red

distinctiveRules.rule: Bar segments get a 2px corner radius on outside corners only; larger radii are forbidden.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do use 2px corner radii on outside corners of bar chart segments.

distinctiveRules.rule: Bars are 12-24px wide with at least 8px between bars; show fewer bars rather than going denser.
distinctiveRules.quote: Do maintain between 12px and 24px wide bars with a minimum of 8px padding between them.

distinctiveRules.rule: Show at most 3 data sets by default (max 5 if the user opts in).
distinctiveRules.quote: Do show a max of 3 data sets per graph by default.

distinctiveRules.rule: Only horizontal gridlines in #e5e5e5; axis label text #191919; legend text #707070.
Legend ('key') sits under the chart, left-aligned, ordered bottom-up (reverse of stack/tooltip order).
distinctiveRules.quote: The key under the graph should be in the opposite order since the key represents building the segments from the bottom up to the top.

distinctiveRules.rule: Title is required, bold, top-left, 1-2 words, sentence case, no ending punctuation.
distinctiveRules.quote: Required. Titles name the data being visualized ... Aim for 1-2 words

distinctiveRules.rule: On hover the tooltip appears above the selected period and all other shapes fade to 30% opacity.
distinctiveRules.quote: This will open a tooltip above the selected time period and all other shapes on the graph fade to 30% opacity.

distinctiveRules.rule: Axis labels at least 16px apart and never angled; skip every other label or wrap to two lines.
distinctiveRules.quote: Don't place axis labels too closely together or angle the text.

distinctiveRules.rule: Line graphs use their own palette: blue #0968f6, violet #271a68, teal #006f93, pink #de458e, dark pink #a51359 - not interchangeable with bar/area colours.
Chart sits in a white rounded card with optional tab set (underlined active tab) and pill drop-down controls (e.g. 'Last 90 days') top-right.
distinctiveRules.quote: Controls ... can be tabs, quick filters or drop-downs that are either left aligned or right aligned.

referenceImages.describes: Anatomy diagram: white rounded card on light grey. 'Chart title' bold black top-left; pill drop-down 'Last 90 days' top-right; tab row (Tab 1 ... Tab 6) with bold underlined active 'Tab 5'. Stacked bar chart of 12 months (Oct-Sep): navy (#002a69) bottom segment, bright blue (#0968f6) middle, light-blue diagonal-hatched top segment with blue outline; thin white gaps between segments; narrow bars with tiny rounded outer corners. Thin light-grey horizontal gridlines only; y-axis labels $0-$60k on the RIGHT; x labels short months in grey below. Legend at bottom-left: small rounded squares (navy, blue, hatched) each followed by 'Label'.

Seller Hub 'Performance > Sales' page: four light-grey rounded KPI cards with uppercase small labels (TOTAL SALES), large bold numbers ($2,683,141), green up-triangle '69.6% vs prior period'. Below, bold section title 'Total sales' left with two pill drop-downs right ('Total sales', 'Last 90 days'). Dense daily stacked bar chart (navy base, blue middle, hatched light-blue top), faint horizontal gridlines, y labels $0/$100k/$200k/$300k on the right, date labels 'Nov 18 ... Dec 18' every third bar.

Stacked bar chart thumbnail: six narrow bars on light grey, navy bottom, bright blue middle, light-blue hatched top segment with a blue outline; white separators between segments; ~2px rounded outer corners; no axes.
